नैषध m. 1. A king of the Nishāda country; 2. a native of that country; 3. an epithet of king Nala.
नैष्कर्म्य n. 1. Idleness, inactivity; 2. exemption from acts or their consequences, Bg.iii.4; 3. the salvation obtained by abstraction.

नैष्ठिक (I) a. (f. की) 1. Final, last, R.viii.25; 2. decided, fixed, firm, constant; 3. highest, perfect; 4. completely versed in; 5. vowing perpetual abstinence and chastity.
नैष्ठिक (II) m. A perpetual religious student who continues with his religious preceptor after the prescribed period, (op. to उपकुर्वाण q.v.). See Yaj.i.49.
